title: Space Drums shared contract definitions
description: Shared $defs referenced by every record schema (Phase 01, Task 01.2, docs/architecture/contracts.md). Units: time in seconds on the single monotonic clock t_mono (ADR-0004); positions ROI-normalized, origin top-left, y increasing downward (ADR-0005); angles in radians measured from +x towards +y. This file defines no record on its own.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the record. Each record schema pins a const value; a breaking change bumps the major part and is recorded by an ADR with migration notes.

t_mono.description: Instant in seconds on t_mono (monotonic, process-wide, ADR-0004). Never milliseconds; never wall-clock.

t_mono_or_null.description: t_mono instant, or null when the event has not happened / is not applicable.

frame_id.description: Monotonically increasing per session, assigned by capture; a dropped frame consumes no id (drops are counted in FrameSample.dropped_since_last).

hand_id.description: Tracked-point identity. V1: the two hands. The identity space is declared open by contract (docs/architecture/contracts.md section 2.3): a future non-hand tracked point (OOS-REF:REQ-207, e.g. a foot) is added by a schema-version bump + ADR, never by reusing LEFT/RIGHT.

point2.description: [x, y] in ROI-normalized units (nominally [0,1]^2; values outside are permitted and mean 'outside the ROI'). Exactly two components in schema_version 1.x; an optional depth component would be a version bump (out-of-scope register REQ-206 note).

vector2.description: [vx, vy] in ROI-normalized units per second (or per second squared for accelerations).

unit_vector2.description: [ux, uy], unit length (|u| = 1 within floating-point tolerance; enforced by the consumer, not by the schema).

rect_px.description: [x, y, w, h] in full-frame pixels, origin top-left.

rect_norm.description: [x, y, w, h] in ROI-normalized units.

confidence.description: Confidence / probability in [0, 1]. Semantics are defined by the producer and named by its *_id field.

tip_method.description: Tip-estimation method (README section 14). MARKER is a fallback / benchmark condition only (REQ-211) and must be labelled as such wherever a result derived from it is reported.

candidate_source.description: Origin of a StrikeCandidate (README section 9; ADR-0008). Invariant with arm: REACTIVE <-> A, RULE <-> B, MODEL <-> C-* (enforced on CommittedStrike).

candidate_derivation.description: How a StrikeCandidate was derived. GEOMETRY = geometry.intersect over a trajectory (trajectory-first, ADR-0007; the only derivation permitted in the live application). DIRECT_HEAD = from a DirectPrediction's heads without geometry; diagnostic harness modes only (Phase 09 C-GBDT direct mode, Phase 19 AB-NOTRAJ), source MODEL only, always labelled 'direct / no-trajectory (diagnostic)' in results.

arm.description: Baseline / system arm (README section 9). Same enum as schemas/experiment-log.schema.json minus NA.

trigger_type.description: Zone trigger type. V1 implements HAND_TIP only. The enum is OPEN by contract: FOOT is reserved (OOS-REF:REQ-207, ADR-0011) and is added by a schema-version bump + ADR, not by editing this list in place.

zone_id.description: Stable zone identifier (ADR-0003): snare, hihat, tom1, tom2, floor_tom, crash_ride, ... Layout positions live in config, never in the id.

identifier.description: Free-form stable identifier (detector_id, anticipator_id, camera_profile_id, ...). Producers document their values.

opaque_id.description: Unique id for a candidate / strike / episode within a session (e.g. '<session>-<hand>-<counter>'); uniqueness is the producer's responsibility.
